hero.title: Your Coach. Your Guide. Your Accountability Partner.
hero.description: Every entrepreneur is assigned a trained EPEW Business Coach who serves as a trusted guide throughout the entrepreneurial journey.

neverAlone.title: No Entrepreneur Should Walk the Journey Alone.
neverAlone.paragraph1: Every entrepreneur deserves someone who believes in their potential, understands their challenges, and helps them stay focused on the path to success.
neverAlone.paragraph2: An EPEW Coach becomes a trusted advisor, mentor, facilitator, and accountability partner who helps entrepreneurs move confidently from idea to successful business ownership.

whatCoachDoes.title: What Does an EPEW Coach Do?
whatCoachDoes.description: A business coach partners with entrepreneurs to develop their business ideas, clarify their vision, establish strategic goals, and build actionable plans that move them toward business success.

roles.title: The Role of an EPEW Coach
roles.description: Our trained coaches serve as strategic advisors, facilitators, and accountability partners who empower entrepreneurs to unlock their potential, strengthen their skills, overcome roadblocks, and drive sustainable growth.

advisor.title: Strategic Advisor
advisor.text: Helping entrepreneurs make informed business decisions and strengthen their business direction.

development.title: Business Development Partner
development.text: Transforming ideas into structured business opportunities through planning and preparation.

facilitator.title: Facilitator
facilitator.text: Connecting entrepreneurs with professional support, service requests, and ecosystem resources.

accountability.title: Accountability Partner
accountability.text: Helping entrepreneurs stay focused on milestones, responsibilities, readiness, and commitments.

leadership.title: Leadership Mentor
leadership.text: Developing confidence, leadership skills, entrepreneurial thinking, and responsible decision-making.

ibos.title: IBOS Coordinator
ibos.text: Using IBOS to monitor progress, update milestones, coordinate workflows, and track entrepreneur readiness.

accomplish.title: What Coaches Help Entrepreneurs Accomplish
accomplish.description: EPEW coaches help entrepreneurs move from ideas to organized, prepared, and business-ready opportunities.

journey.title: The EPEW Coach Journey
journey.description: EPEW coaches guide entrepreneurs through a structured development journey from assignment to business growth.

assignment.title: Assignment
assignment.text: An entrepreneur is matched with an EPEW Coach.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.text: The coach learns the entrepreneur’s goals, vision, strengths, and challenges.

development.title: Development
development.text: The entrepreneur receives coaching, preparation, and business development support.

readiness.title: Readiness
readiness.text: The coach helps prepare the entrepreneur for funding readiness and business launch.

growth.title: Growth
growth.text: The coach continues supporting accountability and business progress.

philosophy.title: The EPEW Coaching Philosophy
philosophy.description: We believe entrepreneurs succeed when they receive consistent guidance, accountability, preparation, encouragement, and professional support. EPEW coaches do not build businesses for entrepreneurs. They develop entrepreneurs who build successful businesses.

qualifications.title: Who Can Become an EPEW Coach?
qualifications.description: EPEW welcomes qualified individuals who have experience, professionalism, leadership, and a passion for helping entrepreneurs succeed.

business.title: Business Professionals
business.text: Professionals with experience in business, management, operations, finance, or consulting.

entrepreneurs.title: Entrepreneurs
entrepreneurs.text: Experienced entrepreneurs who understand the challenges of building and growing a business.

educators.title: Educators
educators.text: Teachers, trainers, and mentors who know how to guide people through learning and development.

community.title: Community Leaders
community.text: Leaders committed to strengthening communities through entrepreneurship and economic opportunity.

retired.title: Retired Executives
retired.text: Retired professionals who want to use their experience to guide new entrepreneurs.

service.title: Service-Minded Professionals
service.text: Individuals passionate about helping entrepreneurs unlock potential and build sustainable businesses.

responsibilities.title: Coach Responsibilities
responsibilities.description: EPEW coaches support entrepreneurs through guidance, accountability, milestone review, and coordinated preparation.

impact.title: Every Great Entrepreneur Has Someone Who Believed in Them.
impact.description: Behind every successful entrepreneur is someone who encouraged them, challenged them, guided them, and helped them keep moving forward. EPEW coaches help create stronger businesses, stronger families, and stronger communities.

commitment.title: The Coach’s Commitment
commitment.description: As an EPEW Coach, I commit to guiding entrepreneurs with integrity, professionalism, accountability, respect, and encouragement. I will help entrepreneurs prepare for success while empowering them to lead their own businesses with confidence and responsibility.

statement.title: No Entrepreneur Should Walk the Journey Alone.

cta.title: Become an EPEW Coach
cta.description: Help develop entrepreneurs. Help strengthen communities. Help transform lives through entrepreneurship.
